stories.title: BFF session proxy and auth foundation
stories.driver: Net-new BFF proxy route handlers + session provider + typed auth module; cookie relay and credential/connectivity error typing, no existing pattern to reuse — the shared surface the rest of the epic depends on.

stories.title: Login screen with credential and connectivity error states
stories.driver: Single form from existing Shadcn primitives, but two distinct error states (401 vs connectivity+retry), keyboard/a11y wiring, and a spec gap (lockout) to resolve.

stories.title: Role-based landing routing and route protection
stories.driver: Creates the (app) protected route group every later page nests under; role-to-landing mapping, redirect-when-signed-out, and in-page permission-denied banner — routable with 3 Playwright ACs.

stories.title: Application shell with role-gated navigation and sign-out
stories.driver: Persistent nav with role-gated visibility, identity display, sign-out + back-button invalidation, responsive collapse, and a11y — broad surface but composed from primitives.

stories.title: Session lifecycle — idle warning and timeout handling
stories.driver: Idle/absolute timers, 60s countdown warning, 401-driven sign-out; client-side only (spec gap, no refresh endpoint) and timer-based tests are fiddly.

stories.title: File Logs Dashboard
stories.driver: Full data table replacing the placeholder — server-fetched list plus client-side sort, 5/10/20/50 pagination, multi-field filter bar with chips + clear-all, two distinct empty states, status badges, and row drill-through (6 ACs).

stories.title: Upload a Transaction File
stories.driver: Drag-and-drop dropzone + picker fallback, File Setting fetch, octet-stream upload with progress, success/retry, connectivity-vs-validation error split, and Importer-only route gating.

stories.title: File Detail — Summary & Status-Count Drill-Through
stories.driver: New shared /files/[id] page: fetch + client-side status-count summary (Total/Imported/Approved/Rejected), count drill-through links, BR4 work-in-progress banner, loading/not-found states.

stories.title: File Lifecycle — Validation Errors, Retry & Cancel (Importer)
stories.driver: Layers Importer-only mutations onto file detail: dynamic validation-error grid from a JsonArray + column endpoint, retry-validation, destructive cancel-confirm modal, BR7 approved-transaction block (client-side derived), and full role-gating of all three controls.
